description: Trait de côte - Sillon de Kerloziou, Dirinon (Finistère) - 1966-2005 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tel.archives-ouvertes.fr. Study of the kinematics of the coast line of Kerloziou, located in the municipality of Dirinon (region Brittany, Finistère). Type of space entity: point Format: digital coordinates in X and Y Objectives: studying coastal line kinematics for 60 years in response to climatic variations and/or marine weather conditions. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline — Sillon de Kerloziou, Dirinon (Finistère) — 1966-2005" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Installations de suivi environnemental. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
